sources.snippet: The text tower is quantized (NVFP4 attention/MLP/GDN projections + FP8 dynamic down_proj); the vision tower ships unquantized bf16 (model-visual-bf16.safetensors) so image fidelity is untouched.

sources.title: SargeDev/JEV-27B-Uncensored-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The first uncensored member of the JEV 27B family. The AutoTrust System-1 decision block (calibrated typed decisions: yes/no · choice 2-256 · score 0-5, one forward pass) has been merged into huihui's abliterated Qwen3.8-27B backbone, so the decision engine answers WITHOUT the stock model's refusal wiring.
